stories.title: The Lakers score 121.9 a game through 11 games, the most in the NBA
stories.dek: Los Angeles has scored 115 or more in 9 of 11 games, including 121 without Luka Doncic on Sunday.

stories.title: Stephen Curry scored 41 to pass Gilgeous-Alexander for 2nd in scoring
stories.dek: Curry averages 31.2 points a game, behind only Doncic's 40.1, as the Warriors won their 7th straight.

stories.title: Luka Doncic is averaging 40.1 points through 9 games, the first since Wilt
stories.dek: His 53 points against Portland on Friday gave him 361 points in 9 games, 10.2 clear of the NBA's next scorer.

stories.title: The Spurs have won 7 straight after losing their first 2 games
stories.dek: Victor Wembanyama's career-high 52 points beat Dallas by 1, and San Antonio now owns the NBA's longest win streak.

stories.title: The 8-1 76ers have the NBA's best record with its 9th-best point differential
stories.dek: 7 of Philadelphia's 8 wins have come by 11 points or fewer, and 5 of them by 6 or fewer.
stories.hero_stat: 8-1, the NBA's best record, on a plus-5.8 differential

stories.title: Luka Doncic is averaging 38.5 points a game, 8.4 clear of the NBA's next scorer
stories.dek: He has scored 40 or more in 5 of his 8 games, and his 5.9 3-pointers a game also lead the league.
stories.hero_stat: 38.5 points per game, 8.4 clear of the next scorer

stories.title: No NBA team is unbeaten after Memphis lost 135-134 to New Orleans
stories.dek: Memphis was the league's last unbeaten team, and the best records in the NBA are now 7-1.
stories.hero_stat: No unbeaten team remains; best records are 7-1

stories.title: The Grizzlies are 6-0, the NBA's only unbeaten team
stories.dek: Memphis beat Sacramento 136-105, and its plus-15.2 point differential leads the league.

stories.title: The Pistons allow 101.8 points a game, the fewest in the NBA
stories.dek: Detroit is 5-1 after holding Brooklyn to 94 points, and no opponent has scored more than 113 against it.
stories.hero_stat: 101.8 points allowed per game, fewest of 30

stories.title: The Timberwolves' plus-14.8 point differential leads the NBA
stories.dek: Minnesota is 4-2 after beating the Clippers 127-101, and its 89-point total margin is the league's largest.
stories.hero_stat: plus-14.8 points per game, best of 30 teams

stories.title: The Grizzlies are 5-0, joining the Rockets as the NBA's only unbeaten teams
stories.dek: Memphis beat Portland 124-103, holding a team that entered the night averaging 129.3 points to 103.

stories.title: The Kings are 0-5, the NBA's only winless team after losing to New Orleans
stories.dek: Sacramento lost 132-120 to a Pelicans team that entered the night 0-4, and has the league's worst per-game differential at minus-16.6.

stories.title: The Rockets are 5-0, the NBA's only team with 5 wins
stories.dek: Houston has outscored opponents 615-544, a plus-71 differential, after a 132-100 win at Milwaukee.

stories.title: The Celtics won by 35 points, then by 1 the next night
stories.dek: Boston beat Chicago 134-99, then beat Brooklyn 125-124 in overtime behind Jayson Tatum's 40 points.

stories.title: The Trail Blazers score 129.3 points a game, the most in the NBA
stories.dek: Portland is 3-0 after a 136-129 win at Los Angeles, the highest-scoring game of the last 2 nights.

stories.title: The Thunder are 4-0 and allow 100.8 points a game, fewest in the NBA
stories.dek: Their 4 opponents averaged 117.4 points in their other games and 100.8 against Oklahoma City.
